headline: Rooppur power plant's first unit begins 350MW trial supply to nat'l grid
summary: The first unit of the Rooppur power plant began a 350MW trial supply to Bangladesh's national grid. Initial grid connection will last 8-10 hours, followed by further tests and a 10-month trial operation.
why: Rooppur is Bangladesh's first nuclear power plant, and its output is expected to add significant baseload electricity capacity to the country's grid.
